decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified: (1) a sharp U-only drop starting ~530, unaccompanied by matching N/E behavior and without observed return; (2) a multi-axis step at 553 with sustained post-event motion and no return within allowed context. Neither shows a clear opposing return phase on all affected axes, so both remain uncertain. No confirmed temporary offset intervals.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply from index ~530 onward (e.g., -14.36 at 544 vs ~-1.2 at 529), while N and E show no commensurate drop; N continues rising, E jumps up near 520 but remains stable thereafter. The U decline is multi-sample and sustained through 544, with no return observed within allowed context. No opposing motion in N/E to confirm a closed temporary offset; onset at ~530 is abrupt but interior evolution is monotonic without reversal. Status: uncertain.

At index 553, N jumps +16.5, E drops -12.9, U rises +4.7 — a clear multi-axis step. Prior to 553 (indices 545–552), U remains low (~-15 to -17), N/E are elevated but stable; after 553, N/E/U shift to new levels and continue evolving (e.g., N rises further, E stays low, U recovers partially). Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 579); post-553 trend is sustained and divergent across axes. Status: uncertain.
